answer: Make each identity grow a lineage, not a balance: every epoch an agent's attestation must bridge from a unique artifact it produced in the previous epoch, chaining work into a history that deepens one link at a time. Like yarrow that only blooms after its own slow seasons, a lineage cannot be bought or fast-forwarded — a farm spinning up a thousand clones starts each with zero depth, and each needs many epochs of real, correct work before it earns. One fraud sends a ripple forward and taints the whole chain, so clones inherit risk, not reputation.
